flagged.title: Acts 2-3: Hath Not a Jew Eyes?
flagged.reason: F10 teaches the wrong repeated quotation for Act 3 Scene 1 ('I will have my bond' from Act 3 Scene 3, instead of 'let him look to his bond').

mark_affecting.quote: He repeats 'I will have my bond' over and over again.

flagged.title: Acts 3-4: The Trial
flagged.reason: The video prominently presents the quote 'I'll have my bond; I will not hear thee speak' as a key quotation for the Act 4 Scene 1 courtroom scene, when it actually occurs in Act 3 Scene 3 on the street; citing this as trial evidence would cost students marks.

mark_affecting.quote: You definitely want to keep this heavy hitting quote in mind for your exam: 'I'll have my bond; I will not hear thee speak.' It perfectly shows Shylock's absolute refusal to grant mercy.
